Term1: Antibiotic Prophylaxis for GI Endoscopic Ultrasound FNA Procedures
Text:
# Antibiotic Prophylaxis for GI Endoscopic Ultrasound FNA Procedures

The purpose of antibiotic prophylaxis during GI endoscopy is to reduce the risk of iatrogenic infectious complications.

# Cystic lesions along GI tract including mediastinum:

Antibiotic prophylaxis is recommended before a FNA for cystic lesions along the GI tract to prevent cyst infection.

# Recommendation:

# INPATIENT:

Levofloxacin 500 mg PO q24h for 4 days, beginning 60 minutes before
endoscopic procedure ($) [R,DI]

# OUTPATIENT:

Levofloxacin 500 mg PO q24h for 4 days, beginning 60 minutes before
endoscopic procedure ($) [R,DI]

# Solid Lesions along the upper or lower GI tract:

Antibiotic prophylaxis is not recommended before a diagnostic EUS or EUS-FNA of solid lesions along the upper or lower GI tract.
